topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the introductory framing and goals for the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate pathogen recognition and pattern recognition receptor pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor signaling.

topics.label: Inflammatory response execution, leukocyte recruitment, and systemic escalation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells initiate local inflammation, orchestrate leukocyte extravasation into tissues, promote lymphatic drainage, and can trigger systemic complications like sepsis.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the active and passive mechanisms that terminate inflammation, repair damaged tissue, and result in chronic inflammation or granulomas when resolution fails.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and preview
topics.groupedBecause: It provides the closing framing and previews the upcoming lecture on the complement system.
